rows.note: Use 結 as the all-purpose everyday noun for a physical knot in string or a tangle in hair.

example.english: I tied a knot in my shoelace, and I can't undo it.
example.traditional: 我條鞋帶打咗個結，點解都解唔開。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tiu4 haai4 daai2 daa2 zo2 go3 lit3 dim2 gaai2 dou1 gaai2 m4 hoi1

rows.note: Use 節 specifically for the nautical speed unit, as in a boat travelling at twelve knots.

example.english: This boat is travelling at one knot.
example.traditional: 呢艘船而家以一節嘅速度行緊。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau1 syun4 ji4 gaa1 ji5 jat1 zit3 ge3 cuk1 dou6 haang4 gan2

rows.note: Use 困境 when knot is metaphorical and means a difficult situation rather than a physical knot.

example.english: They finally found a way out of the knot they were in.
example.traditional: 佢哋終於搵到方法擺脫呢個困境。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou3 fong1 faat3 baai2 tyut3 ni1 go3 kwan3 ging2
